name: Blood Shaper (Geomancer Archetype)
body:
Some geomancers seek power through the blood and life force of others, embodied by the blood running in their veins. These geomancers are called blood shapers.

Blood Communion

At 1st level, whenever a blood shaper communes with the spirits to prepare their daily geomancer spells, they can attune to the Blood element instead of the Earth, Fire, Metal, Water, or Wood elements. The Blood element has no pairing or complimentary element, but neither does it have an counteracting or opposing element.

Blood Element

Any spell with blood in its name, the blood descriptor, or those specifically mentioned in the Blood Element Spells sidebar on page 6.

This ability alters spells.

Prohibited Magic

At 1st level, a blood shaper is penalized when they cast certain spells. A blood shaper treats any spell from the schools of evocation and illusion and any spell with the shadow descriptor as prohibited spells. While a blood shaper may prepare and cast a prohibited spell, if they do so, they take a -1 penalty to all d20 rolls they make until the next time they commune with the spirits to regain their daily spells. This penalty stacks with itself. A blood shaper may spend 2 ki points (see below) to remove a -1 penalty incurred from casting a prohibited spell.

Ki Pool (Su)

At 1st level, a blood shaper gains an internal reservoir of ki points derived from cursed spiritual energy that can be used as described below.

Once per day, when a blood shaper communes with the spirits to prepare their spells, their ki pool is replenished to full. A blood shaper’s ki pool can hold a number of ki points up to their Wisdom modifier.

A blood shaper can replenish a maximum of 1 ki point during any round into their ki pool through any one of the following ways:

Cursed Symbiosis

Whenever a creature that has HD equal to or more than 1/2 the blood shaper’s HD fails their initial saving throw to resist being afflicted with a curse effect created by the blood shaper. A blood shaper can only replenish 1 ki point in this way once each day per curse effect on each creature.

For example, a blood shaper with blood curse (see blood magic below) can replenish 1 ki point the first time a qualifying creature fails their saving throw against blood curse within a 24 hours period.

Subsequent successful uses of the same blood shaper’s blood curse on the same qualifying creature within that time period do not replenish any ki points. However, a blood shaper can attempt to replenish additional ki points with blood curse in this way through other qualifying creatures.

Feast of Death: Whenever a blood shaper kills a sapient creature (Int score 3 or higher) that has HD equal to or more than 1/2 the blood shaper’s HD (minimum 2 HD).
Sin Eater: Whenever a blood shaper spends at least 15 uninterrupted consecutive minutes consuming an amount of harmless edible meat in lbs. equal to 3 or their Wisdom modifier, whichever is higher.

Consuming harmless edible meat for this effect does count towards satisfying a blood shaper’s satiety or sustenance needs, and does not otherwise negatively impact the blood shaper’s health. A blood shaper can only replenish ki points in this way each day equal to 1 + once per every 5 blood shaper levels.

A blood shaper stacks their geomancer levels with another class that provides a ki pool to determine the total number of ki points they possess in their combined ki pool. However, only one ability score modifier is added to the combined ki pool; this choice, once made, is permanently set. A blood shaper now uses ki points from this combined ki pool to power the abilities of any class ability they possess that requires ki points.

This ability replaces guardian spirits.

Blood Magic: Once per round, a blood shaper may expend 1 ki point from their ki pool to achieve one of the following effects:
Potency of Ichor (Su)

Starting at 1st level, as a free action, a blood shaper may add a +1 bonus to a single caster level check or concentration check they make.

This bonus increases by +1 every 3 blood shaper levels after 1st.

Blood Rapture (Su)

Starting at 1st level, as a standard action, a blood shaper may select 1 target creature (within 5 feet per blood shaper level) that they can see, causing that creature’s blood to expel violently. This attack deals an amount of hit points damage equal to the bloodshaper’s Wisdom modifier, to a maximum of the blood shaper’s geomancer level. This can only affect creatures with blood and does not affect creatures that are immune to critical hits. At 10th level, a blood shaper can spend 2 ki points for this ability to instead deal an amount of damage equal to 2d6 + their Wisdom modifier.

Blood Curse (Su)

At 2nd level, at will, as a standard action and expending 1 ki point, a blood shaper can target a creature within 30 feet with blood curse. Blood curse functions as a witch’s evil eye hex, except that it is also considered a mind-affecting effect. A blood shaper uses their blood shaper level as their effective witch level and their Wisdom modifier for determining both the save DC and duration of this ability. This can only affect creatures with blood and does not affect creatures that are immune to critical hits.

This ability replaces rebuke spirits.

Esoteric Elemental Mastery

At 5th level, a blood shaper adds the Blood element as one of the elements available for elemental mastery. This ability alters elemental mastery.

Blood Magic Arts (Su)

Starting at 6th level, and again at 12th and 18th level, a blood shaper may select one of the options below. For the purposes of determining the effects and meeting the prerequisites of a selected option for blood magic arts, a blood shaper instead uses their Wisdom modifier and their effective sorcerer or witch class level is equal to their blood shaper level. A blood shaper may select any of the options below up to 3 times each.

Blood Magic Hex: You can select any one witch hex.
Bloodline Art: You can select any one bloodline mutation without being a bloodrager or sorcerer. Any selected bloodline mutation only takes effect on geomancer spells you cast that belong to the Blood element or whenever you successfully used blood rapture, subject to the daily uses of the selected bloodline mutation.
Feat: You can select any one blood hex feat.

This ability replaces spiritual boon and exorcism.

Sanguine Sage

At 20th level, a blood shaper may attune to both the Blood element and another element whenever they commune and prepare their geomancer spells. A blood shaper does not gain the ethereal jaunt ability but they develop a frightening degree of control over their own blood.

A blood shaper no longer ages and can’t be magically aged. They do not take penalties to their ability scores from aging and remove any penalties already accrued from aging. A blood shaper still accrues age bonuses as normal, but they cannot die of old age when their time would be up. Because of their profound control over their own blood, a blood shaper is immune to bleed, poisons, diseases (including magical diseases), and the sickened and nauseated conditions unless they choose to be affected.

This ability alters spiritual master.

Blood Element Spells

Several existing spells gain the blood descriptor. Such spells also qualify as belonging to the Blood element for geomancers at the appropriate spell level below. Spells with the blood descriptor from any product are also considered Blood element spells.

0th–bleed, stabilize; 1st–blood money, instant clot, phantom blood, touch of bloodletting; 2nd-adhesive blood, blood armor, blood blaze, blood in the water, blood of the martyr, blood transcription, bloodbath, boiling blood, brow gasher, detect relations, enemy’s heart, life pact, mark of blood, transmute wine to blood; 3rd–aqueous orb (loses the [water] descriptor; the created orb is made of blood instead), blood biography, blood sentinel, martyr’s last blessing, symbol of exsanguination, toxic blood, waves of blood; 4th-blood song, caustic blood; 5th-blood boil, blood tentacles, blood ties; 6th–bloodsworn retribution; 7th-expel blood, plundered power, recorporeal incarnation; 8th-death clutch; 9th–transmute blood to acid.
